name: Ningbo Changhong Polymer Scientific and Technical Inc.
summary: Ningbo Changhong Polymer Scientific and Technical Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of styrene-based thermoplastic elastomers in China and internationally.
